obernants.approximation_semantics: Source-derived exact target relation; finite evidence is not a general proof.
obernants.assumptions: Successful allocation; exact bytes and stated transformation premises.
obernants.domain: Finite declared fixture executions with successful compilation and allocation.
obernants.operator: Within finite tested observations, exclude suite acceptance if any expected value disagrees with its independently specified oracle or asserted conditional law. Unvisited cases are not excluded by finite testing.

obernants.operator: Pattern a*b on length-four binary texts accepts exactly those with first byte a and final byte b; ?*b* requires b after the first position. Several accepted texts witness nonunique Boolean preimages.
